task_description: GitHub issue #30: Rebalance the wide-screen (>=760px) two-column layout so the right column is no longer short with a large empty bottom-right gap (caused by #19 moving the chat UI into the left column). Move StatsPanel into the right column (left = sprite + chat, right = stats + care + battle) and preserve the #19 single-column (<760px) stacking order sprite -> chat -> stats -> care -> battle. Layout/CSS + JSX element placement only; no logic/i18n/dependency changes. Verify wide + narrow with Playwright. Frontend-only (orchestrator redeploys).
